dedupe_keys.name: water pump dataset for a water supply system

description: Carmen Cheh and colleagues publish one-minute sensor records from a university's potable and non-potable pumping systems, covering July 2023 to July 2024. The September 2024 deposit provides CSV files and a detailed Markdown description free under CC BY-SA 4.0. Measurements include tank level in millimetres, pressure in bar, pump vibration speed and displacement, sensor temperature, three-channel power and current, and cumulative energy in kWh. The documentation identifies tank washing, delayed activation from PLC signal failures and pump failures, with event dates. These records can calibrate pump-operation simulations or test fault detection and digital twins against labelled operating disturbances. They describe one university installation, whose identity and geographic location remain unknown. The provider warns that sensor issues can create missing values; one-minute means also conceal faster transients. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified. The README was inspected, but the sensor files were not downloaded.
